digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider('gemini-*') maps to 'google_genai', which is not in pydantic-ai's known providers or ProviderSession builders, causing LLMConfigError at runtime
model_classes._resolve_target composes unqualified gemini model ids using the unmapped provider name, resulting in provider construction failure during gate execution
anthropic_model._pai_model applies a private fallback table that masks the defect for bare cfg.model usage but not for qualified model-class paths
gemini-prefixed model ids are plausible at config time but fail only when gates actually run
_PROVIDER_PREFIXES must map gemini to 'google', the canonical provider name in pydantic-ai for Gemini Developer API models
